Next, find the proper divisors of 220. The prime factorization of 220 is \(2^2 \times 5 \times 11\), so its positive divisors are 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20, 11, 22, 44, 55, 110, and 220. Excluding 220 gives the proper divisors: 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20, 11, 22, 44, 55, 110. Their sum is \(1+2+4+5+10+20+11+22+44+55+110 = 284\).

Thus, the sum of the proper divisors of the sum of the proper divisors of 284 is 284.
